title: ShoppingListsView: search and create-list flow
description: Extend `ShoppingListsView.swift` with: (1) `.searchable` modifier (prompt "Search shopping lists") filtering card rows by case-insensitive name substring and showing a search-no-match empty state when active search yields nothing; (2) a floating action button (bottom-trailing `.borderedProminent` circle with `plus` icon, hidden when search is active); (3) the create-new-list `.alert` triggered by the FAB — name `TextField` (placeholder "Name (e.g., 'Weekend BBQ')"), disabled "Create" until non-empty, name sanitisation (trim + replace `/` with `-`), duplicate-name inline error, on success writes `# <name>\n` to disk, appends to in-memory list, and pushes the new list's detail view.
acceptance_criteria: Card rows filter by case-insensitive name substring during search
Search-no-match empty state shows `magnifyingglass` icon and "No matches" title
FAB is visible when search is inactive; hidden when search is active
FAB tap presents `.alert` with title "New shopping list" and a name TextField
"Create" button is disabled until name is non-empty after trimming whitespace
Name sanitisation: leading/trailing whitespace trimmed, `/` replaced with `-`
Duplicate file name shows inline error and retains the typed name for editing
Successful create writes `# <name>\n` file, appends entry to in-memory list, and auto-pushes the detail view
